title: Ali Hamed – Creative Investing  - [Invest Like the Best, EP.71]
summary: But the key word in that last sentence isn’t alpha, it’s earning. The conversation, with a 26-year old investor named Ali Hamed, serves as an example of what’s possible when you think creatively. Ali views the world with a fresh set of eyes, and has already become an expert at identifying new investment opportunities where others have not.

thesis: The episode argues that Microsoft faces structural hurdles to adopting blockchain due to its existing business interests, while the speaker holds a bearish view on Coinbase, citing government opposition to currency competition and a belief that Bitcoin's current utility is overshadowed by speculation. The speaker expects Bitcoin's practical use cases to catch up by 2025, particularly in hard-to-reach regions, though the current market sentiment is described as disconnected from the actual significance of the technology.
